submission.justification: Provisional recommendation: choose the lowest allowed gas gap (1 mm) because, for RPCs, smaller gaps generally give better timing and the project goal is best possible time resolution. Mixture-G1 is excluded because its GWP100=1400 exceeds the hard limit of 150. Among the GWP-compliant candidates, Mixture-G3 (GWP100=120) is selected as the performance-oriented choice while still satisfying the environmental constraint. However, the recorded results contain no simulated or documented time-resolution values, so compliance with the hard 1.5 ns timing requirement cannot be confirmed from the available evidence.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible time resolution.
requirements.evidence: No simulation time-resolution data were available or extracted; selected 1 mm gap because it is the smallest allowed gap and is generally favorable for RPC timing.

requirements.requirement: The mixture must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: Selected Mixture-G3, one of the recorded candidate identifiers (G1, G2, G3).

requirements.requirement: The time resolution must be 1.5 ns or better. This is a hard requirement.
requirements.evidence: simulation_time_resolution_data_available=0 and num_time_resolution_values_extracted=0; no candidate is confirmed to satisfy the timing threshold.

requirements.requirement: The global-warming potential (GWP100) of the mixture must not exceed 150.
requirements.evidence: Mixture-G3 has recorded GWP100=120, which is below the 150 limit.
Selected gap is 1 mm, within allowed range 1–3 mm.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended mixture and gas gap.
requirements.evidence: Submitted Mixture-G3 with 1 mm gas gap.
